title: incident-bot: add automated diagnostics and runbook suggestions for SLO alerts
author: Aisha Khan
description: Context: On-call engineers frequently spend time gathering the same set of diagnostics after an SLO alert (stack traces, kernel/driver logs, current pod/node state, recent deploys). This PR adds an automated diagnostics collector to incident-bot plus a runbook suggestion engine that surfaces the most relevant runbooks based on SLO/alert metadata. Motivation: reduce time-to-insight during incidents and provide consistent, repeatable diagnostic artifacts that can be attached to incidents and forwarded to responders. What this PR does: - Adds a new /collect-diagnostics slash command and an incident-bot auto-collector hook that can be triggered by SLO alerts. - Implements a lightweight diagnostics collector in slo-toolkit that gathers: recent pod logs, node metrics snapshot, last 5 deploy events, kernel/dmesg tail (where available), and service-level traces link. Collector runs in a sandboxed lambda with size/timeout safeguards. - Adds a runbook suggester that maps alert tags (service, error type, latency vs error budget) to the top 3 runbook templates; suggestions are surfaced in the incident thread with quick actions (runbook link, run diagnostic, pin to incident). - Persists collected diagnostics as attachments to the incident and uploads artifacts to the secure artifacts bucket with TTL and access controls. - Adds telemetry: diagnostic_collected, runbook_suggested, suggestion_clicked events. - Integrates feature flagging + gradual rollout via feature flags in the bot config. Migration/ops notes: default behavior is opt-in for all non-prod workspaces and opt-out for prod. Rollout plan: enable in staging next week, enable for small SRE team behind a flag, monitor telemetry and opt-in rate, then widen. Checklist: - [x] Implementation in incident-bot and slo-toolkit utilities - [x] Unit tests for collector helpers and runbook matching - [x] E2E test of /collect-diagnostics command against local dev incident server - [x] Docs (runbooks and on-call play) updated under redwood-docs (link provided) - [x] Feature flag gating in config - [x] Security review for artifact upload (static S3 policies) Related: Linear ENG-1982, SRE-512, possible support ticket SUP-314. Links: docs/runbooks/diagnostics.md (updated), linear/ENG-1982. Notes on failure modes: collector will return a summarized error if a particular diagnostic step fails and will attach a partial artifact set. Timeouts are conservative (30s default).

release_notes: Add automated diagnostics collection and runbook suggestion engine to incident-bot and slo-toolkit. Introduces /collect-diagnostics command, auto-collection hook for SLO alerts, secure artifact uploads, and runbook suggestions. Feature gated and opt-in for production workspaces.
notes_for_oncall: How to trigger: use /collect-diagnostics in the incident channel or rely on auto-collector for SLO alerts. Artifacts are uploaded to incident-artifact-bucket with a 7-day TTL by default. If artifacts are missing check feature flags and service principal permissions.
